capabilities.definition: Explain a visually indicated entity using cited encyclopedia evidence and explicit uncertainty.
capabilities.selection_rationale: Selected because object detection and encyclopedia lookup provide a grounded visual-to-text path.
capabilities.title: Grounded visual encyclopedia

capabilities.definition: Identify the same catalog product from grounded product-retrieval evidence.
capabilities.selection_rationale: Selected because the product gallery and image/text retrieval contracts can provide product-level evidence.
capabilities.title: Exact product match

capabilities.definition: Separate multiple visible products and return grounded candidates for each requested item.
capabilities.selection_rationale: Selected because object detection and product retrieval form an implemented composition path.
capabilities.title: Multi-product decomposition and search

capabilities.definition: Return relevant but meaningfully diverse style alternatives grounded in the product gallery.
capabilities.selection_rationale: Selected because the style-similarity tool exposes a diversity-aware retrieval contract.
capabilities.title: Style-diverse recommendation

capabilities.definition: Transcribe or extract requested fields from an approved document image while retaining line evidence.
capabilities.selection_rationale: Selected because document OCR exposes line-level evidence and an approval-gated runtime contract.
capabilities.title: Grounded document reading

capabilities.definition: Provide recipe guidance for an identified dish using cited recipe evidence and explicit uncertainty.
capabilities.selection_rationale: Selected because recipe lookup provides a separate cited evidence path with distinct safety constraints.
capabilities.title: Grounded recipe guidance

intents.definition: The user asks for the same catalog product rather than a merely similar item.
intents.title: Exact match intent

intents.definition: The user asks to separate, identify, search, or compare more than one visible product.
intents.title: Multi-product intent

intents.definition: The user asks for relevant alternatives whose usefulness depends on both similarity and meaningful diversity.
intents.title: Divergent recommendation intent

intents.definition: The user asks for factual explanatory knowledge about a visually indicated entity.
intents.title: Visual encyclopedia intent

intents.definition: The user asks for a supported practical operation on visible objects, documents, or dishes.
intents.title: Visual utility intent
